correctness.rationale: On the specified 12-vertex, 30-edge, degree-5 icosahedral pole/two-staggered-ring graph, neighbor-only synchronous majority is F(x)_v=1 iff popcount(x & N(v))≥3. An independently implemented complete enumeration of all 4096 binary states checked pointwise F^7=F^5; found exactly 14 fixed states, 156 primitive unordered two-cycles, first-periodic-entry histogram (326,986,984,1080,480,240), and basins 16×2,60×4,60×6,20×14 for cycles, unanimous 1586 each, cap fixed 1 each. A second full spatial-automorphism orbit computation found the 120 graph automorphisms and seven temporal-cycle symmetry classes of sizes 6,10,20,30,30,30,30; all population-pair and weight-class counts matched. The manuscript also proves cap nonnucleation symbolically: the ten prescribed neighbor inequalities force pole inputs (1,0), A+B=5, ring equalities and all top-ring ones, so the only cap predecessor is itself. All 4096 inputs are the COMPLETE finite mathematical domain; the exhaustive certificate is a legitimate finite proof, not sampling.
residual_risks: Graph is the ordinary 12-vertex icosahedral graph; self-inclusive or asynchronous update is a different map.
The full 1980 Goles–Olivos article was not inspected, though its known general period≤2 theorem is acknowledged.
